tasks.goal: Patrol the flood-defense embankment route along the Thames Barrier viewing path, logging gate and pier conditions as progress telemetry.
tasks.terrain: Grass-topped river embankment, gravel viewing paths, gentle 22.4 m relief slopes; watch bollards near Barrier Point and moored MV Royal Iris.
success: Complete 3 waypoint loops without manual recovery
safety_stops: Stop if any human enters 2 m forward cone
E-stop on tilt > 20 degrees near embankment edge
Pause in heavy rain or wet-grass slip detection
tasks.human_in_loop: Person reviews the patrol log and approves publication of condition findings to the Progress Observatory display.

tasks.goal: Greet visitors, recite the charter summary, and deliver printed charter cards between the display plinths.
tasks.terrain: Level indoor polished floor; cable runs near exhibit plinths, low glass cases, standing visitors.
success: Speech playback completes at each stop with < 5 s idle gap
No collisions with plinths or visitors over 20-min run
safety_stops: Stop and step back if visitor within 0.8 m
Shutdown speech on operator interrupt
Dock to charger below 15% battery
tasks.human_in_loop: Steward approves the charter wording NAO recites before public deployment.

tasks.goal: Carry a wireless mic pod between proposal speaker stations in the tiered forum seating during debate sessions.
tasks.terrain: Carpeted tiered debate floor with step edges, chair legs, loose cables from AV racks.
success: Complete 6 mic-pod handoffs within session window
safety_stops: Freeze if speaker reaches toward mic pod
Sit and wait if any person within 1 m on stairs
Abort if mic dock signal lost > 5 s
tasks.human_in_loop: Forum moderator triggers each mic run and may cancel mid-route.

tasks.goal: Retrieve labeled evidence binders from shelf bays and place them on the review desk for the Evidence Monitor station.
tasks.terrain: Flat lab floor; shelf rows 0.9 m apart, rolling carts, server rack for Six Degrees Data Centre style heat near one wall.
safety_stops: Abort grasp if binder weight estimate > 3 kg
Stop base if person enters workspace
Pause if thermal reading near rack exceeds 35 C
tasks.human_in_loop: Researcher confirms binder set list each morning before autonomous runs.

tasks.goal: Fine-position task-board pegs on the operations console table while operators update the task-routing board.
tasks.terrain: Fixed tabletop station; desk edge, monitors, coffee cups within arm reach envelope.
success: Joint velocity limits respected 100% of run
safety_stops: Reflex stop if external force > 20 N
Stop if hand detected in workspace camera
Disable on operator console e-stop button
tasks.human_in_loop: Operator presses enable before each session and can stop the arm anytime.

tasks.goal: Lay and route low-voltage cable segments into the overhead tray above the working-group desks.
tasks.terrain: Overhead tray at 2.2 m, ceiling fixtures, ladder racks; ensure floor zone below stays clear.
success: Route 5 cable segments without kinks detected
safety_stops: Reduced speed mode when person below tray
Protective stop on force anomaly > 15 N
Stop if tray-mount vibration exceeds threshold
tasks.human_in_loop: Facilities person approves tray layout and lockout before cable runs.

tasks.goal: Inspect pallet rows and dock doors at the Sainsbury's Distribution Centre edge zone used for DAO logistics staging.
tasks.terrain: Asphalt yard with dock levelers, pallet stacks, truck movement zones, standing water after rain near River Thames edge.
success: Autonomous mission of 400 m with no falls
Report generated and uploaded within 5 min
safety_stops: Sit and power down if vehicle within 5 m
Avoid standing-water zones flagged in terrain map
Operator deadman hold required near dock edges
tasks.human_in_loop: Logistics steward reviews inspection report and clears pallet rows for use.

tasks.goal: Fly a slow perimeter scan of the Charter Hall ceiling to verify lighting and display integrity for the exhibits.
tasks.terrain: Indoor airspace under 6 m ceiling: pendant lights, banner cables, mezzanine railings at Heron Place style balconies.
success: Complete 2 ceiling laps with < 0.2 m tracking error
safety_stops: Land immediately on position estimate loss
Avoid 1 m bubble around any person
Return-to-launch below 20% battery
tasks.human_in_loop: Hall manager authorizes flight window and confirms airspace clear before launch.
